methods.label: Identify common factors
methods.explanation: In \((x^2-y^2)/(x+y)\), the factor \(x+y\) can be canceled; in \(2x/(4y)\), the factor 2 can be canceled; and \((x-y)/(y-x)=-1\) can be reduced. However, \(x+y\) and \(x^2+y^2\) have no common factor, so \((x+y)/(x^2+y^2)\) is in lowest terms.
